ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher per NS-7; no driver account flag warranted.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's claim to have waited more than 3 minutes before cancelling is contradicted by the system timestamps: 'I'm Here' at 13:02:45 and cancellation at 13:05:40 give only 2 min 55 s, short of the ≥ 3:01 required by NS-1(iii).
